target.semantics: On a DataNode, allKeys.get(keyId) checks whether its block-token key cache contains the key used by a peer's encrypted-transfer SASL handshake. A missing key raises the selected exception. NameNode exportKeys reaches the DataNode through registration/heartbeat key-update paths, which are separate from the later data-transfer connection. No cross-thread shared-state edge is inferred solely from this source path.

original_test.source_review: The selected method calls testEncryptedRead without an expected InvalidEncryptionKeyException. It restarts a MiniDFSCluster with encrypted transfer and block-access tokens, then reads a file and its checksum. With the default null trusted-channel resolver, the DataNode encrypted SASL handshake should ask its BlockPoolTokenSecretManager for the key. The class is JUnit Parameterized with two resolver values; the trusted resolver can bypass the handshake.
original_test.runner_gap: The historical Surefire -Dtest=TestEncryptedTransfer#testEncryptedReadDefaultAlgorithmCipherSuite invocation ran zero JUnit tests with Maven BUILD SUCCESS. The current class-level selector would run other methods including testFileChecksumWithInvalidEncryptionKey and testLongLivedClientPipelineRecovery, which intentionally clear or expire keys. Therefore class-level output cannot serve as a clean healthy seed for this one check unless the exact selected throw is absent in the actual trace. A method selector that executes only the desired parameter variants remains unverified.

source_backed_alternate.source_review: This existing nonparameterized JUnit enables encrypted data transfer and block-access tokens and delegates to TestBalancer.testBalancer0Internal. That helper starts a MiniDFSCluster, writes a file, adds a DataNode, and balances data. It has no source-level expected missing-key exception, but whether it reaches the exact retrieveDataEncryptionKey guard must be measured in a healthy seed.

identity_gap_and_versioned_fix.explanation: DataXceiver.run invokes datanode.saslServer.receive before decoding an operation; the old adapter scopes DataXceiver.readBlock only, so the selected BlockTokenSecretManager check inside the earlier handshake could be recorded as unknown. The source patch scopes DataXceiver.run using its concrete registered datanode receiver and retains the existing readBlock scope. The transform was verified offline against the compiled DataXceiver class; neither the exact healthy target nor its runtime actor is yet attested.
identity_gap_and_versioned_fix.build_result: Isolated Maven test package succeeded; adapter project has no tests. Offline transformation smoke confirmed DataXceiver.run and readBlock both call HdfsHooks.datanodeEnter. No live JAR was replaced.
